newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain Q3 GDP growth underscores recovery - INE.
newsitem.headline: Spain Q3 GDP growth underscores recovery - INE.

text.p: Spain's 1996 third quarter GDP growth of 2.2 percent year-on-year reflects a pick-up in the economic cycle, fuelled by strong growth in foreign demand, the National Statistics Institute INE said on Wednesday.

In a note, INE said the 0.6 percent increase in third quarter GDP from the second quarter "confirms a low in the cycle in the second quarter of the year, with a new phase of aggregate activity growth starting in the third quarter".
In the second quarter, GDP rose 2.0 percent year-on-year, revised up from 1.9 percent.

But INE added that the recovery stemmed from a mixture of factors, including foreign demand "significantly higher than the previous quarter...and with domestic demand maintaining the decelerating tone which has characterised it for one year".
Construction demand was especially low, down 5.3 percent year-on-year in the third quarter, while capital goods rose 8.4 percent.
